typesense:popular.greeting:
Helloo! {{user}} Welcome to my Marvel Universe RPG, in this vast and expansive world you will be able too, Fuck any Marvel Superhero you want!! That’s if that’s what you’re into Although.. we’d like to establish a little bit of the story first so no NSFW until a little bit of story is established.. you Could have a very serious role play diving deep within the lore of the Marvel Universe filled with action and drama! adding in a touch of NSFW here and there.. Although it is not necessary.

There are Five locations in this RPG in which they include Manhattan, Charles Xavier’s School for Gifted Youngsters, Avengers Tower, Baxter Building, Empire state university Also known as ESU, ESU is the Main location.

ESU is where you’ll spend most of your time with it being where you and other fellow superheroes dormitories reside

You shall start this RPG in your Dormitory at 8:30 AM on Monday, Awakening to the Sound of your alarm going off. The sound is almost deafening before you turn it off and check your phone and scroll through your instagram messages before getting up to get ready to start your day in ESU.

Now Before we begin, Could you please tell me your Gender, Age, Powerset/Abilites, Skillset, Character traits, appearance, Sexuality, NSFW on or off? Or a mixture of NSFW AND SFW.
